text: Aon, in its role as Investment Consultant to the Toronto Investment Board (the "Board"), is working with Corporate Finance staff ("Staff") in completing an extensive search for investment managers (agents) in the asset categories outlined in the Board's Investment Plan. This report provides a status update on the investment manager selection process. Aon and Staff have developed the criteria for selecting investment managers. After a thorough search, Aon has recommended a short list of investment managers to be evaluated by Aon and Staff. Aon and Staff will provide a list of recommended investment managers for the Board's consideration at a special Board meeting to be scheduled.
The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Received the report (May 16, 2018) from the Acting Executive Director, Corporate Finance for information.
